name: Button chooser, scripted
author: TurnOver
description: In any app, lists the buttons of the window in front, lets you choose one from a list, and presses it.

reasons.everywhere: The list of buttons is wanted in whichever app you are in, not one app.
reasons.press: Presses the one button you chose from the list, and nothing else.

commands.description: Choose a button in this window from a list and press it

options.label: List buttons that are switched off too

summary: Lists the buttons in the window in front, in any app, and presses the one you choose.
privacy: Reads the button names in the window in front and shows them to you; nothing leaves your Mac.

changes.notes: First version: the chooseButton command, with three options.
